meta.title: Fix #2753: Handle large inputs in memory by chunking text before embedding
meta.body_summary: Implement chunking of large texts before embedding to prevent token limit crashes in RAG memory, with configurable chunk size and overlap constants.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added chunking to prevent embedding token limit crashes; AI crew provided feedback and PR was updated, but closed after 8 days of inactivity without human approval.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 151 changed lines, this is a small fix by absolute volume. It fits a targeted memory-handling improvement, but the PR was closed due to inactivity rather than merged.

review_details.concern_detail: AI crew reviewer suggested improved method documentation, type hints, chunk processing optimization, constant documentation, and edge case tests (empty input, exact size). Devin addressed these in a follow-up commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent token limit crashes by chunking large texts before embedding, improving memory handling.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by bot after 7+ days of inactivity; no human approval or merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin can implement a chunking fix and respond to AI-generated review feedback, but without active maintainer engagement and formal approval, the PR remains unmerged and eventually closed by the bot for inactivity.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; only unit test verifying chunking logic, no performance validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge by inactivity bot after no further maintainer action despite addressed feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Added MEMORY_CHUNK_SIZE and MEMORY_CHUNK_OVERLAP constants, implemented _chunk_text method in RAGStorage to split large texts into chunks, and modified _generate_embedding to loop over chunks and add each to collection. Added tests for large input and edge cases.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Constants added for configuration; test file covers large input and edge cases.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Implement _chunk_text, update _generate_embedding, add constants, and create large input test.
Follow-up commit: Improve documentation and add edge case tests as per AI review feedback.
